question: For a specific metal, the threshold frequency is $\nu_0 = 4 \times 10^{14} \text{ Hz}$. If the incident light has a frequency of $3 \times 10^{14} \text{ Hz}$ but its intensity is increased by a factor of 100, what will be the effect on the photoelectric current?

options.A: The current will increase by 100 times
options.B: A small leakage current will flow
options.C: No photoelectric current will be observed
options.D: The current will be emitted but with very low kinetic energy
